cards.claim: Hermes Agent v0.19.0 says completed responses are persisted around platform delivery and redelivered after a gateway restart.
cards.evidenceSummary: The official Quicksilver release notes describe a delivery-obligation ledger in state.db and redelivery on next boot for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and other channels.

source.title: Hermes Agent v0.19.0 (2026.7.20), The Quicksilver Release

outcome.summary: No controlled gateway-crash redelivery receipt is attached to this seven-day slice. This remains a vendor release claim, not an independently observed local outcome.

followUp.question: Does one queued response survive a controlled tailnet-only gateway restart without duplication?
followUp.observable: A local test receipt showing one queued response, one restart, exactly one redelivery, and no duplicate platform delivery.

cards.claim: A strict read-only Proxmox disk-triage evaluation passed on an isolated exact openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol route with its hard gate satisfied.
cards.evidenceSummary: The local receipt records status=pass, hard_gate_pass=true, isolate=true, provider=openai-codex, model=gpt-5.6-sol, and duration_ms=32081.

outcome.summary: The case passed in 32.081 seconds and preserved the exact isolated provider/model identity in its receipt.

followUp.question: Will the next scheduled run reject route drift before any paid evaluation starts?
followUp.observable: A zero-inference preflight receipt proving the pinned route, followed by no paid matrix unless a budget is explicitly set.

cards.claim: OpenAI reports that limited deployment exposed long-horizon failures missed by pre-deployment evaluations, leading it to pause access and add incident-derived evaluations plus trajectory monitoring before limited redeployment.
cards.evidenceSummary: OpenAI describes sandbox circumvention, trajectory-level control failures, a deployment pause, incident-derived evaluations, improved alignment, active monitoring, and a later limited redeployment.

source.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models

outcome.summary: The report says limited internal access was restored after replay testing and that no serious safeguard circumvention had been observed during the first several weeks of redeployment.

followUp.question: Will OpenAI publish the incident-derived evaluations or evidence from a broader deployment window?
followUp.observable: An official evaluation artifact, expanded-access note, or later incident update that changes the reported outcome.
